candidate.title: scTrio-Seq
candidate.scope: Single target: scTrio-seq (also styled scTrio-Seq), as labeled by the assigned Illumina schematic and matching catalogue page. Extract the whole drawing, including RNA-to-cDNA, directly adapter-bearing DNA, and MspI/bisulfite-DNA routes, with branch-specific PCR/sequencing and alignment. Resolve its implementation against Hou et al. (PMID 26902283): separated RNA and scRRBS libraries jointly report transcriptome, CpG methylation and CNVs; the separately drawn unconverted-DNA route is retained as schematic content but is not established as a third library of that implementation. scMT-seq, scRRBS and general scRNA-seq are not additional target workflows; scRRBS is an embedded component.

method_scopes.rationale: The title and caption identify only scTrio-seq. All listed operations describe its diagram-level RNA and scRRBS architecture, with the nuclear-DNA release interface explicitly supported by the primary paper. RNA carrier addition and TDT tailing retain the diagram-level depiction; the primary paper is not claimed to independently spell out those steps. The direct-DNA adapter, PCR/sequencing and alignment instances remain in the graph to preserve what Illumina draws, but are excluded from the experimentally supported implementation: Hou et al. derive CNVs and methylation from the same scRRBS DNA readout. The physical separation, poly(T)-primed RNA branch and paired cell origin are primary-supported. The card calls scMT-seq a related prior method, while the scMT-seq paper describes a distinct implementation; no synonymy, interchangeability or historical edge is inferred.
